items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: I never did play with him. We never did play with Tom Brown. We were fighting against one of them.

ctx.x: Well, there's Tom Brown. Tom Brown. Is he living yet? No, he's dead. He's dead, too, yeah. He just died a year ago.
I never did play with him. We never did play with Tom Brown. We were fighting against one of them. A little bit late, a hot stuff. Yeah. So we outgrew them. And... Not a bad thing.
Do you remember the Detroit brothers? Detroit, yeah. Detroit, yeah.
